decisions.reason: Although adjacent to airport operations, a passenger check-in mobile app sits relatively farther from the firm’s strongest security and operational know-how, and with no visible follow-on market evidence after launch the firm would likely reallocate resources to offerings where it can learn and improve faster.

Passenger processing technology fits closely with the firm’s integrated airport security and efficiency expertise, and its in-house technology capability gives it enough absorptive capacity to refine and commercialise this product despite limited external R&D intensity in the industry.

A self-service airline check-in solution is related to the client base but is more peripheral to the firm’s core security competence and appears commercially weak or non-prioritised after launch, so management would likely focus on the more central passenger-processing technology instead.
